references.title: 黄河1855年铜瓦厢改道
references.publisher: 水利部黄河水利委员会
references.excerpt: 咸丰五年(1855年)六月，黄河在河南兰考北岸铜瓦厢决口……夺大清河，汇入渤海。铜瓦厢以下数百里南流河道自此废弃，成为废黄河。
references.application: Ming/pre-1855 scenes omit the modern lower Yellow River main stem east of 114.5 E. HydroRIVERS MAIN_RIV 40417973 is identified from reaches at the present Jinan Yellow River; ORD_CLAS=1 identifies the main stem. No medieval replacement geometry is invented. Tributaries and upstream reaches remain modern geographic context.

references.title: 卢沟桥与永定河名称沿革
references.publisher: 北京市丰台区人民政府
references.excerpt: 清康熙三十七年(1698年)，皇帝命令河道总督于成龙整治卢沟，疏浚河道并筑长堤，并赐名永定河。
references.application: Ming context labels the named Yongding reach as 卢沟河. Geometry remains modern geographical context; the name substitution does not claim reconstruction of the Ming channel.

otherLimits: Natural Earth Reservoir features are omitted from historical scenery; modern lake and ocean outlines remain geographic context.

Natural Earth Zhang is a generalized downstream record. The 漳河 label is restricted west of 115.4 E, and 海河 is restricted east of 117.1 E; these are label applicability windows, never reconstructed river boundaries.
HydroRIVERS contains hydrologic geometry and stream order, not historical Chinese river names. Names are sourced separately; modern drainage topology is not evidence for ancient battles.
